name: Aurorazhdarcho
isnote: Bennett (2013) synonymised its type species A. primordius with “Pterodactylus” micronyx, and in 2025 argued that both are juveniles of Gnathosaurus subulatus. If accepted, Aurorazhdarcho would become a junior synonym of Gnathosaurus; kept separate here pending further study.
sum: Small ctenochasmatoid from the early Tithonian of Bavaria; one specimen, the ‘Pester Exemplar’, may be the first pterosaur fossil ever documented.
holotype: Type species A. primordius; the Pester Exemplar (holotype of A. micronyx) is a juvenile skeleton without skull, Solnhofen region.
exceptional: The Pester Exemplar was first misidentified as a crustacean in the 18th century.
biology: A small lagoon-dwelling pterodactyloid; ctenochasmatoids are generally associated with shorelines and small aquatic prey.
author: Frey et al. 2011
